The AI Debate Gets More Complicated: Microsoft Has a Win, Meta Stumbles | The Weekly Wrap

Eisman abandons his Charter recommendation after worsening broadband losses. He separates hyperscaler infrastructure moats from vulnerable model-provider economics, warns about customer concentration and price competition, and favors selective AI beneficiaries. The earnings discussion contrasts cloud growth with capital intensity and revisits FICO, Meritage, payment companies and portfolio risk.

Conditional reasoning

Deductive counterexample: a higher population mean is compatible with some individuals having lower incomes. A mean cannot establish the universal claim.
